question_text: Explain why the speed of transmission of impulses is faster along a myelinated axon than along a non-myelinated axon.

points.text: (In myelinated) saltatory (conduction) OR (In myelinated) depolarisation at nodes (of Ranvier);
In non-myelinated depolarisation occurs along whole/length (of axon);

other_guidance: 2 and 3. 'Messages' or 'signals' disqualifies first of these marks credited.
